description: This file contains definitions for difficulty level descriptions and a function to generate a detailed prompt for creating medical multiple-choice questions, including instructions, formatting, and example questions.

methods.name: get_generation_prompt
methods.description: Generates a comprehensive prompt for creating medical MCQs based on difficulty, context, and image context, including instructions, formatting, and examples.

methods.name: get_validation_prompt
methods.description: Creates a prompt for reviewing and validating a generated MCQ, focusing on accuracy, clarity, and quality criteria.
